fields.name: heroIntro

fields.initialValue: Bring your skills to a locally rooted team working with communities across Northeast Nigeria to advance dignity, resilience and peace.

fields.name: cultureTitle
fields.title: Section heading
fields.initialValue: Your work can meet a real need.

fields.name: cultureIntro
fields.title: Section introduction
fields.initialValue: JDPI works across humanitarian response, recovery and development. Roles may support programmes in communities or the teams that make that work possible.

fields.name: cultureOneText
fields.title: First focus description
fields.initialValue: Work alongside people and local structures, listening before acting and keeping dignity at the centre.

fields.name: cultureTwoText
fields.title: Second focus description
fields.initialValue: Programmes, operations, finance, communications and support roles all contribute to responsible delivery.

fields.name: cultureThreeText
fields.title: Third focus description
fields.initialValue: Our work is grounded in the communities and realities of Borno, Adamawa and Yobe States.

fields.name: openingsTitle
fields.title: Vacancies heading
fields.initialValue: Find your place in the work.

fields.name: openingsIntro
fields.title: Vacancies introduction
fields.initialValue: Explore current JDPI opportunities. Each listing gives the duty station, engagement type, deadline and official application instructions.

fields.name: emptyText
fields.title: No vacancies message
fields.initialValue: New opportunities will appear here when JDPI publishes them. Please check back for an opening that matches your skills.

fields.name: processTitle
fields.title: Process heading
fields.initialValue: A clear path from interest to application.

fields.name: processOneText
fields.title: First step description
fields.initialValue: Read the full description, duty station, requirements and closing date.

fields.name: processTwoText
fields.title: Second step description
fields.initialValue: Use the application link or JDPI email shown on that vacancy. Include the requested information.

fields.name: processThreeText
fields.title: Third step description
fields.initialValue: If shortlisted, JDPI will contact you about the next stage using the details in your application.

fields.name: safetyText
fields.title: Application safety message
fields.initialValue: Apply only through the instructions on an official JDPI vacancy. If someone requests payment or bank details during recruitment, pause and verify the request through JDPI’s contact page.

fields.name: accessText
fields.title: Accessibility message
fields.initialValue: If an application format is difficult for you to use, contact JDPI and mention the vacancy title so the team can discuss an accessible way to apply.
